RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 45

An all-male panel and delayed feedback are legitimate concerns that may point to unconscious affinity bias. However, for a head of risk modelling, broad regulatory and governance experience is frequently prioritized over pure statistical depth, making the appointment plausible on merit alone.

Whether to raise it depends on your objective. If your goal is constructive feedback or keeping doors open, mentioning the panel's gender composition will likely put the bank on the defensive and close down dialogue. If you suspect unlawful discrimination and intend to pursue a formal grievance or legal claim, preserve the panel's composition as supporting evidence and consult an employment lawyer once you follow up on your feedback request.
